provenance_and_replay_limits.detail: All 189 frozen entries and inspected study JSON manifests lack mode fields. Current original/copied modes are captured; historical mode equality is unprovable from these records.
Initial self-log diagnostic binds an older writer. No exact backup was found among adjacent original-root verifier/draft files. Final script bytes are not a reconstruction of that version.
Current draft differs; no adjacent Stage5 handoff backup was found. Historical draft omitted; four other recorded context inputs still match.
Its hash for logs/final-preflight-verification.log is the empty-file digest, not the completed log digest. Original record retained verbatim and excluded from final accepted binding claims.

Original records identify Apple clang 21.0.0, GNU Fortran 16.2.0, macOS/SDK and eight Homebrew dylibs by versioned paths, but do not freeze their binary hashes or acquisition URLs. Host executable hashes for Python/Git/make and the complete inherited environment are also not recorded. No new host interrogation or downloads performed.

Seven Git archives have exact frozen hashes and matching PAX commit comments. Primary URLs identify commits, not hosted downloads with those exact tar bytes. Original git archive shell receipts are not retained; inferred reconstruction guidance is labelled.
Both retained Stage1 CRAN source archives have exact frozen hashes and existing official-index links. Their original request receipts are not in this 189-file collection.

Logs retain actual compiler/linker/configure lines, but dedicated scripts for every download/export/extraction, nm/otool call, initial loaded-image printing and R4.6.1 existing-install smoke were not separately indexed. Do not present the selected final recipes as exact source for every earlier inline diagnostic.
